title: Simulation of stochastic volatility models via operator splitting schemes
abstract: arXiv:2609.21301v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The standard Euler discretization schemes for numerical option pricing under stochastic volatility models are known to exhibit high biases and potential unreliability. The alternative use of the exact (unbiased) simulation approach invariably involves numerical evaluation of integrated variance (and / or volatility) conditional on terminal variance (volatility) value. To resolve the technical challenge, most simulation schemes either employ the tedious Fourier inversion of conditional characteristic function or numerical approximation by moment matched distribution. We propose a general framework of constructing efficient and reliable simulation schemes for stochastic volatility models via the Strang operator splitting approximation. The simulation procedure completely circumvents the necessity of evaluation of conditional integrated variance (and / or) volatility. translated_title: 基于算子分裂格式的随机波动率模型模拟
translated_abstract: 众所周知，在随机波动率模型下用于数值期权定价的标准Euler离散格式存在高偏差和潜在的不可靠性。而替代采用的精确（无偏）模拟方法则总是需要对以终端方差（波动率）值为条件的累积方差（和/或波动率）进行数值评估。为了解决这一技术难题，大多数模拟方案要么采用繁琐的条件特征函数Fourier逆变换，要么采用矩匹配分布的数值近似。我们提出了一个通过Strang算子分裂近似来构建高效且可靠的随机波动率模型模拟方案的通用框架。该模拟过程完全避免了对条件累积方差（和/或波动率）进行评估的必要性。我们的模拟方案与大多数现有的精确模拟方案相比表现出良好的竞争优势。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Strang算子分裂近似的通用框架来构建高效可靠的随机波动率模型模拟方案，完全避免了求解条件累积方差（和/或波动率）的数值难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a general framework for constructing efficient and reliable simulation schemes for stochastic volatility models via Strang operator splitting approximation, completely circumventing the need to evaluate the conditional integrated variance (and/or volatility).
